findings.status: source-reviewed candidate awaiting parent SQL/native reproduction
findings.issue: Ordinary-table check can resolve an attacker-defined table named pragma_table_list instead of the built-in table-valued pragma. The guard then trusts attacker-supplied schema/name/type rows and can admit a view, contradicting the documented rejection-before-evaluation boundary.
findings.trigger: Create main.pragma_table_list(schema,name,type) and insert ('main','SPECTRUM','table'); define SPECTRUM as a view. Calling read_ms1_spectra uses FROM pragma_table_list with no parentheses, then SELECT ID,MSLEVEL FROM main.SPECTRUM. An aggregate over a nonterminating recursive CTE in the view can prevent the first result row, before the row budget can stop work.
findings.evidence: Read source guard and subsequent scan. SQLite name-resolution consequence not executed by this reviewer; integrator notified for reproduction. Both handler modules use the same unqualified non-call spelling.
findings.proposed_fix: Use the table-valued pragma call spelling pragma_table_list() or another non-shadowable schema-inspection mechanism, verify actual ordinary tables still work, and add a harmless shadow-table+view regression before considering nonterminating views. Do not execute an unbounded trigger.
findings.impact: Malformed or adversarial databases; ordinary source-produced sqMass files unaffected.

findings.status: confirmed different arithmetic path; concrete boundary candidate awaiting parent reproduction
findings.issue: The source routes center +/-0.01 through decimal formatting and SQL parsing; Rust compares raw f64 endpoints. This intentional-or-accidental precision difference is absent from native_differences and boundary tests.
findings.trigger: Small accepted center0.12345678901234567; source lower endpoint is formatted to0.113456789012346 while native lower retains approximately0.11345678901234568. A target equal to the native lower boundary is included by Rust but excluded after source endpoint rounding. Numerical values are source-derived candidate, not executed here.
findings.evidence: Followed through StringUtils::toStr -> appendToStr -> NumericFormatting::appendNumeric. Contrary to StringUtils header/comments claiming15 significant digits, the actual formatter uses15 fixed fractional digits for0.01<=abs(value)<1e4 and shortest scientific round-trip outside. Thus an earlier suggested100m/z example was withdrawn; normal100m/z boundaries round-trip. Existing boundary test uses100.0 only.
findings.proposed_fix: Add an explicit native-difference statement and tiny-coordinate boundary regression if retaining direct f64 bounds, or reproduce source formatting where exact compatibility is required. Keep this as native API difference, not automatically a C++ bug.
findings.impact: Extremely small boundary shifts for low coordinate values; no demonstrated effect on ordinary SWATH window centers.
